newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: NEW SLOVAK FOREIGN MIN SAYS POLICY UNCHANGED- TASR.
newsitem.headline: NEW SLOVAK FOREIGN MIN SAYS POLICY UNCHANGED- TASR.

text.p: The appointment of a new Slovak Foreign Minister, Zdenka Kramplova, heralds no change in the country's foreign policy, Kramplova told the official Slovak news agency TASR on Friday.
"There are no reasons for that (change)," TASR quoted Kramplova as saying.
"Membership of NATO and the European Union and good relations with neighbouring countries remain our priorities," she added.

Earlier this week, Kramplova, the first Slovak women foreign minster, replaced Pavol Hamzik who resigned in protest at the domestic political situation and failed referendums on NATO membership and direct presidential elections.
The appointment of Kramplova, a little known figure whose party affiliations are unclear, was pushed by Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar apparently without consulting his coalition government partners.
"We consider it abnormal that we should seek such important personal information just through media," Slovak National Party vice-chairman Anna Malikova told a news conference on Friday.
